narrative.northStar: A tiny heist. Your own trail. A satisfying reveal.
narrative.overview: The Toymaker's Gallery is a bright miniature room shared by the heist and detective phases. Distinct prop silhouettes, lilac architecture, deep plum controls and warm brass treasures make the same actions and clues easy to recognize.
keyCharacteristics: Authored cutaway 3D gallery and clear prop silhouettes.
Portrait-first play with large controls and a single contextual instruction.
Gold heist feedback and mint evidence feedback with text and shape.
Short tactile animation and original gesture-gated synthesized sound.

rules.name: One room, two roles
rules.body: The physical choices made during the heist determine the later clues.

rules.name: Read the next action
rules.body: Keep one short contextual instruction and one visually dominant next action.

rules.name: Match the evidence
rules.body: Pair every distinguishing clue shape or color with readable words.

dos: Keep the gallery visible while the phase changes.
Use at least 44-pixel controls and visible keyboard focus.
Preserve the existing bundled font licenses.
Record actual verification in the delivery PR.
donts: Do not reintroduce the old district-simulation interface.
Do not use the preserved old screenshots as the new game's presentation.
Do not claim physical-device performance from desktop emulation.
